steps: Go to Profile Icon → API (top-right corner of Bybit website)
Click Create New Key → System-generated API Keys
Set API Key Usage: API Transaction (allows reading account data)
Set API Key Permissions: Read-Only (NEVER enable trading permissions)
Give READ permissions for: Trade data (portfolio viewing), Assets data (balance information)
Click Submit and copy your API Key and Secret
notes: Always keep your API Secret secure and never share it. Only enable the minimum permissions required for portfolio viewing.
